_note: BRING PROBE B1 (plan OT-31): one deliver, three iron, silent, placeholder words. Not a mission; MB68a is the first real one.

Reading it, in order: take it with NO iron: the objective reads (0/3). Pick up or buy one: (1/3). Use the drop with one: a box says you need 3 and nothing else happens, the prompt stays. Get to three or more: (3/3), never past 3. Drop one: back to (2/3). Use the drop with three: the iron goes from your pack (only 3 of them if you held more), the job completes and pays.
Iron is the MiscItem InorgCommonIron, what Red Tape counts. Only the player's own pack counts, never the ship's hold.
Any fault is the bring, not the place: MB42a's footlocker on RECenterLocRef at a quiet site. Unbuilt once a real bring has played.
